_about: Texts of the consent screen, the permission lists and the confirmation fieldset, shared by all PUPS implementations (TypeScript through pups-ui, PHP through a copy). Values are HTML; {name} placeholders are replaced with values the caller has already escaped, or, for title.*, with plain text that the page escapes.
consent.didYouMean: Did you mean to log in with {name}?
consent.newApp: New app. You have never approved {app} before.
consent.loopback: This app runs on this computer. It receives your answer at a local address ({address}), as native apps and apps in development do.
consent.footer: Everything the app stores is public, except private data. You can remove the app at any time on the apps page.
notSetUp.intro: An app wants you to log in with {host}, but this Personal Upload Server is not set up yet.
notSetUp.setUp: Set it up now. You need {secret}, and you choose how you log in: a passkey, a password or both.
notSetUp.bootstrapSecret: the bootstrap secret you chose when you deployed it
notSetUp.again: Then go back to the app and log in again.
confirm.passkeyOrPassword: Enter your password, or leave it empty to use your passkey.
confirm.passkey: You will be asked for your passkey.
